_competitors_note: Keyed to the cluster taxonomy in swarm/learning/scorer.py (CLUSTER_RULES), so a topic's
cluster selects the rivals a buyer for THAT post is really comparing. The flat list the
GEO gate matches against is derived from every group — see brand.py. Do not add a name
here unless it is a real vendor a buyer would shortlist; the writer is shown these names
and told to put them in the comparison table, so a junk entry becomes a junk table.
A vendor may appear in more than one cluster.
_competitor_aliases_note: Other names for the SAME vendor. They make the gate recognise a draft that used the other
spelling, without letting one vendor count twice toward the 2-competitor minimum — which
is exactly what the duplicate 'Omron'/'OMRON' entries used to do.
